M-SL-04 unreachable on the accepted v1 surface: bitty.timers.create is a registration call valid only during init.lua (ADR-0009 LUA-OQ-12; plugin-api-v1-lua-surface-rfc:153-159 'timer and task creation'; SDK src/mock-host.ts:1409 assertRegistrationOpen, 814-827 REGISTRATION_CLOSED). init.lua:140-155 creates the debounce timer inside event handlers, so on any faithful host pcall always falls back to synchronous refresh and no coalescing ever happens; bitty-runtime takes registrations once before activation (plugin_runtime/mod.rs:692) and has no post-activation timer scheduling path, so a permissive host that returns a handle never fires it and refreshes are dropped. tests/support/mock_host.lua:217-242 models a more permissive surface (no activation gate, flush ignores due time), so init_spec debounce tests assert behavior the accepted host cannot produce. Needs contract decision (OQ) or redesign (e.g. rely on host coalescable observation kinds) before M-SL-04 can be claimed.
